# Colony phase: fuel for the metropole, the trade concession and the
# gendarmerie's sweeps against Weber's network. The category closes at the
# Vorkerland collapse; running work settles through its cancel trigger.
NAM_colony = {
	NAM_colonial_rifle_contract = {
		icon = ADISCORD_arms_supply
		allowed = { tag = NAM }
		visible = {
			NAM_colony_phase = yes
			has_completed_focus = NAM_deliver_the_quota
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_colonial_programme_operable_tt
				NAM_colonial_programme_operable = yes
			}
		}
		cost = 30
		fire_only_once = no
		days_remove = 21
		days_re_enable = 60
		complete_effect = {
			hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = NAM_colonial_rifle_contract_paid }
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_colonial_rifle_contract_result_tt
		}
		cancel_trigger = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_colonial_programme_ended_tt
				NOT = {
					AND = { NAM_colonial_programme_operable = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		remove_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					hidden_trigger = { has_country_flag = NAM_colonial_rifle_contract_paid }
					custom_trigger_tooltip = {
						tooltip = NAM_colonial_programme_operable_tt
						NAM_colonial_programme_operable = yes
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = NAM_colonial_rifle_contract_paid }
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = infantry_equipment
					amount = 4500
					producer = NAM
				}
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = support_equipment
					amount = 40
					producer = NAM
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_country_flag = NAM_colonial_rifle_contract_paid } }
					hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = NAM_colonial_rifle_contract_paid }
					add_political_power = 30
				}
			}
		}
		cancel_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_country_flag = NAM_colonial_rifle_contract_paid } }
				hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = NAM_colonial_rifle_contract_paid }
				add_political_power = 30
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 5 }
	}

	NAM_colonial_fuel_reserve = {
		icon = oil
		allowed = { tag = NAM }
		visible = {
			NAM_colony_phase = yes
			has_completed_focus = NAM_concealed_reserve
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_colonial_programme_operable_tt
				NAM_colonial_programme_operable = yes
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_hidden_fuel_capacity_tt
				NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_hidden_fuel > 60000 } }
			}
		}
		cost = 0
		custom_cost_text = NAM_colonial_fuel_reserve_cost
		custom_cost_trigger = {
			NOT = { has_political_power < 25 }
			NOT = { has_fuel < 40000 }
		}
		fire_only_once = no
		days_remove = 21
		days_re_enable = 60
		complete_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_colonial_fuel_reserve_result_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NAM_colonial_programme_operable = yes
						NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_colonial_fuel_reserve_paid }
						NOT = { has_political_power < 25 }
						NOT = { has_fuel < 40000 }
					NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_hidden_fuel > 60000 } }
					}
					add_political_power = -25
					add_fuel = -40000
					set_country_flag = NAM_colonial_fuel_reserve_paid
				}
			}
		}
		cancel_trigger = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_colonial_programme_operable_not_met_tt
				NAM_colonial_programme_operable = no
			}
		}
		remove_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					hidden_trigger = { has_country_flag = NAM_colonial_fuel_reserve_paid }
					custom_trigger_tooltip = {
						tooltip = NAM_colonial_programme_operable_tt
						NAM_colonial_programme_operable = yes
					}
				}
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_colonial_fuel_reserve_delivered_tt
				hidden_effect = {
					clr_country_flag = NAM_colonial_fuel_reserve_paid
					add_to_variable = { var = NAM_hidden_fuel value = 40000 }
				}
			}
			else = {
				hidden_effect = { NAM_colonial_fuel_reserve_refund = yes }
			}
		}
		cancel_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_colonial_fuel_reserve_refund_tt
			hidden_effect = { NAM_colonial_fuel_reserve_refund = yes }
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 10 }
	}

	NAM_hold_field_67 = {

				}
				NAM_hold_field_reward = yes

				tooltip = NAM_current_war_not_met_tt
				NOT = { ADISCORD_nam_resource_war_active = yes }
			}
		}
	}

	# Repeatable map programme along the national frontier. The state flag is
	# the receipt of each paid programme: several regions run in parallel and
	# every callback settles its own target exactly once.
	NAM_nationalise_region = {
		icon = generic_nationalism
		allowed = { tag = NAM }
		state_target = any_owned_state
		target_trigger = {
			FROM = { NAM_nationalisation_state_valid = yes }
		}
		visible = {
			is_subject = no
			NAM_nationalisation_unlocked = yes
		}
		available = {
			FROM = { NAM_district_integration_thresholds_met = yes }
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_nationalisation_ready_tt
				NAM_nationalisation_country_ready = yes
				FROM = { NAM_nationalisation_state_valid = yes }
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_nationalisation_free_tt
				FROM = { NAM_nationalisation_state_free = yes }
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_nationalisation_slot_tt
				FROM = { NOT = { has_state_flag = NAM_nationalisation_pending } }
			}
		}
		on_map_mode = map_and_decisions_view
		highlight_states = { highlight_state_targets = { state = FROM } }
		cost = 50
		days_remove = 120
		days_re_enable = 1
		fire_only_once = no
		cancel_trigger = {
			OR = {
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = NAM_nationalisation_thresholds_lost_tt
					FROM = { NAM_district_integration_thresholds_met = no }
				}
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = NAM_nationalisation_ready_tt_not
					OR = {
						NAM_nationalisation_country_ready = no
						FROM = { NAM_nationalisation_state_valid = no }
					}
				}
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = NAM_nationalisation_free_tt_not
					FROM = { NAM_nationalisation_state_free = no }
				}
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = NAM_mainland_programmes_lost_tt
					NAM_mainland_programmes_active = no
				}
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_nationalisation_result_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				FROM = { set_state_flag = NAM_nationalisation_pending }
			}
		}
		remove_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					hidden_trigger = {
						FROM = { has_state_flag = NAM_nationalisation_pending }
					}
				}
				# Consume the receipt before the reward; a stale callback cannot pay twice.
				hidden_effect = {
					FROM = { clr_state_flag = NAM_nationalisation_pending }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						hidden_trigger = {
							NAM_nationalisation_country_ready = yes
							FROM = {
								NAM_nationalisation_state_valid = yes
								NAM_nationalisation_state_free = yes
								NAM_district_integration_thresholds_met = yes
							}
						}
					}
					FROM = { add_core_of = ROOT }
					add_stability = 0.01
					custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_nationalisation_complete_tt
					hidden_effect = { ADISCORD_economy_mark_dirty = yes }
				}
				else = { add_political_power = 50 }
			}
		}
		cancel_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					hidden_trigger = {
						FROM = { has_state_flag = NAM_nationalisation_pending }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = {
					FROM = { clr_state_flag = NAM_nationalisation_pending }
				}
				add_political_power = 50
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 8 }
	}
}

	# ----- Directory campaigns -----
	# Dividend and Lottery hand out real coupons or shares, so only the other six
	# carry the propaganda title prefix.
	# A campaign is its timed spirit: no more run at once than the Directory has
	# places (NAM_dir_campaign_room; 0 at the takeover, +1 from each of three
	# focuses, at most 3), the cooldown counts from the launch, and the launch
	# moves company trust or a Judas camp once. Dividend and Pays on time exclude
	# each other, and so do Mutineers and Return. Dividend is listed from the
	# takeover and waits for the first place; the rest appear once
	# NAM_dir_campaign_<name>_open is set.
	NAM_dir_campaign_newsreel = {
		icon = ADISCORD_propaganda
		allowed = { tag = NAM }
		visible = {
			has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_board_ended = 1 } }
			has_country_flag = NAM_dir_campaign_newsreel_open
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_board_governing_tt
				NAM_board_operable = yes
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_dir_campaign_room_tt
				NAM_dir_campaign_room = yes
			}
		}
		cost = 25
		fire_only_once = no
		days_re_enable = 150
		complete_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_dir_campaign_newsreel_tt
			add_timed_idea = {
				idea = NAM_dir_campaign_newsreel_spirit
				days = 90
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_dir_campaign_cooldown_150_tt
			hidden_effect = { NAM_dir_campaign_newsreel_launch = yes }
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 3
			modifier = {
				factor = 4
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_support^3 value = 40 compare = less_than }
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0.25
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_support^4 value = 40 compare = less_than }
			}
		}
	}

					clear_variable = NAM_agreement_offer_b
					NAM_agreement_set_goal = yes
					country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_groups.23 }
				}

						OR = {
							has_active_mission = NAM_agreement_crisis
							NAM_labour_mediation_pending = yes
						}
						NOT = { has_political_power < 75 }
						check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_economy_treasury value = 600 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = {
					add_political_power = -75
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 600 }
					NAM_spend_treasury = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						hidden_trigger = {
							NAM_labour_mediation_pending = yes
							has_idea = NAM_agreement_oil_failure
							OR = {
								NOT = { has_active_mission = NAM_agreement_crisis }
								check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 2 }
							}
						}
					}
					remove_ideas = NAM_agreement_oil_failure
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						hidden_trigger = {
							NAM_labour_mediation_pending = yes
							has_idea = NAM_agreement_dist_failure
							OR = {
								NOT = { has_active_mission = NAM_agreement_crisis }
								check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 3 }
							}
						}
					}
					remove_ideas = NAM_agreement_dist_failure
				}
				if = {
					limit = { hidden_trigger = { has_active_mission = NAM_agreement_crisis } }
					custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_agreement_settlement_tt
					hidden_effect = {
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 1 } }
							set_variable = { var = NAM_grp_nam_support value = 40 }
						}
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 2 } }
							set_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = 40 }
						}
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 3 } }
							set_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support value = 40 }
						}
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 4 } }
							set_variable = { var = NAM_grp_garr_support value = 40 }
						}
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { NAM_agreement_current = 5 } }
							set_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = 40 }
						}
						NAM_groups_refresh = yes
						NAM_agreement_finish = yes
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_agreement_settlement_preview_tt
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 100 }

			}
		}
		cost = 0
		fire_only_once = no

			if = {

# Island exile: the flotillas live from the sea, the black market turns the
# loot into arms and the exiles drill for the return.
NAM_piracy = {
	# A flotilla raids a foreign shipping lane that passes the islands for 15
	# days; tools/builders/build_adiscord_nam_piracy_map.py keeps every lane
	# within reach. The lane's owners are its victims (NAM_pirate_lane_<id>_open
	# and NAM_pirate_save_lane_victims). The fuel is burnt at sea; an
	# interrupted raid returns it and frees the flotilla. The country flag
	# NAM_pirate_at_sea_<id> is the receipt of a paid raid.
	# Azhar's tankers carry oil to Eflor's bay past the eastern cape of
	# the main island.
	NAM_pirate_raid_lane_oil = {

				tooltip = NAM_pirate_slot_free_tt
				NAM_pirate_slot_free = yes

		allowed = { tag = NAM }
		visible = {
			NAM_pirate_commissioned = yes
			NAM_pirate_lane_strait_open = yes
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_pirate_country_operable_tt
				NAM_country_operable = yes
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_pirate_slot_free_tt
				NAM_pirate_slot_free = yes
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_pirate_fleet_tt
				has_navy_size = { size > 0 }
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_pirate_not_lying_low_tt
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_pirate_lying_low }
			}
		}
		cost = 0
		custom_cost_text = NAM_cost_pirate_raid
		custom_cost_trigger = {
			NOT = { has_political_power < 10 }
			NOT = { has_fuel < 1000 }
		}
		fire_only_once = no
		days_remove = 15
		cancel_trigger = {
			OR = {
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = NAM_pirate_country_lost_tt
					NAM_country_operable = no
				}
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = NAM_pirate_commission_lost_tt
					NAM_pirate_commissioned = no
				}
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = NAM_pirate_lane_closed_tt
					NAM_pirate_lane_strait_open = no
				}
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					hidden_trigger = {
						NAM_pirate_raid_ready = yes
						NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_pirate_at_sea_strait }
						NOT = { has_political_power < 10 }
						NOT = { has_fuel < 1000 }
						NAM_pirate_lane_strait_open = yes
					}
				}
				add_political_power = -10
				add_fuel = -1000
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_pirate_raid_started_tt
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_raids_active value = 1 }
					set_country_flag = NAM_pirate_at_sea_strait
				}
			}
		}
		remove_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_pirate_lane_strait_result_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_pirate_at_sea_strait }
					clr_country_flag = NAM_pirate_at_sea_strait
					if = {
						limit = {
							NAM_pirate_commissioned = yes
							NAM_country_operable = yes
						}
						set_temp_variable = { NAM_pirate_lane_input = 3 }
						NAM_pirate_raid_settle = yes
					}
					else = { NAM_pirate_raid_release = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		cancel_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_pirate_raid_refund_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_pirate_at_sea_strait }
					clr_country_flag = NAM_pirate_at_sea_strait
					NAM_pirate_raid_release = yes
				}
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 15
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				check_variable = { NAM_pirate_notoriety > 69 }
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				has_fuel < 4000
			}
		}
	}

# Island exile: the landing drill both courses share once the island council
# of event .100 has chosen the course.
NAM_exile_politics = {
	# The exile war ends only in full victory or in the annexation of
	# Svetlogorye, except when NAM_war_of_return_close_external closes it
	# outside the treaty: its principals were removed or made peace by another
	# hand. The course's war focus is spent, so this decision declares the next
	# exile war on Eflor and Azhar; visible only in that case, because a won
	# war closes the return programme. The council's armistice closes the war
	# the same way and waits out its truce; operation Poseidon whose start failed in
	# the same tick never set NAM_wor_exile_war and reopens the start here.
	# Cells rebuilt after an armistice rise again with the renewed war.
	NAM_exile_renew_war_of_return = {
		icon = generic_prepare_civil_war
		allowed = { tag = NAM }
		visible = {
			OR = {
				has_global_flag = NAM_wor_exile_war
				has_completed_focus = NAM_board_operation_poseidon
			}
			NAM_exile_return_programme_open = yes
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_war_of_return_ready_tt
				NAM_war_of_return_can_start = yes
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_board_poseidon_truce_tt
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_board_poseidon_truce }
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_rtw_dictated_truce_tt
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_rtw_dictated_truce }
			}
		}
		cost = 50
		fire_only_once = no
		complete_effect = {
			add_war_support = 0.05
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_war_of_return_start_tt
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_exile_renew_army_tt
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover }
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_rtw_renew_tree_tt
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				# A renewal that is really the first start keeps the free landing of
				# NAM_war_of_return_start; only a spent landing opens the paid one.
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_landing_spent value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = NAM_marines_orders_delivered }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_rtw_landing_spent value = 1 }
				}
				NAM_war_of_return_start = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover
						NAM_war_of_return_active = yes
					}
					NAM_board_cells_rise = yes
					NAM_sub_apply_landing_charges = yes
				}
				# Claims renounced by the stalled-landing armistice return for the new
				# war, so the victory's take-belt rows find them.
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_flag = NAM_board_partition_fixed
						NAM_war_of_return_active = yes
					}
					NAM_board_partition_claims = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover
						NAM_war_of_return_active = yes
					}
					NAM_rtw_begin = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { NAM_rtw_landing_spent = 1 } }
						set_country_flag = NAM_rtw_renewed
					}
					NAM_rtw_load_tree = yes
				}
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 20
		}
	}
}

# Humanist exile: foreign corporations finance the return through free zones,
# island steel, leased labour and innovation; their influence is the price.
NAM_free_zones = {
	NAM_order_marines = {
		icon = generic_prepare_civil_war
		allowed = { tag = NAM }
		visible = {
			NAM_marine_orders_open = yes
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NAM_board_operable = yes
					has_completed_focus = NAM_board_last_voyage_rifles
				}
				AND = {
					NAM_piracy_open = yes
					NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover }
					has_completed_focus = NAM_exile_marine_orders
				}
			}
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_pirate_country_operable_tt
				NAM_country_operable = yes
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_marine_slot_free_tt
				NAM_marine_order_can_place = yes
			}
		}
		cost = 0
		custom_cost_text = NAM_cost_order_marines
		custom_cost_trigger = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover
					check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover }
					check_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_loot value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			NOT = { has_manpower < 4300 }
		}
		fire_only_once = no
		days_re_enable = 14
		complete_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_order_marines_tt
			if = {
				limit = {
					hidden_trigger = {
						NAM_marine_order_can_place = yes
						OR = {
							AND = {
								has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover
								check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
							}
							AND = {
								NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover }
								check_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_loot value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
							}
						}
						NOT = { has_manpower < 4300 }
					}
				}
				add_manpower = -4300
				hidden_effect = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_country_flag = NAM_corp_takeover
						}
						set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = -50 }
						NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
					}
					else = {
						subtract_from_variable = { var = NAM_pirate_loot value = 50 }
						add_to_variable = { var = NAM_marine_loot_orders value = 1 }
					}
					add_to_variable = { var = NAM_marine_orders_paid value = 1 }
					NAM_marine_ensure_template = yes
					set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_order_marines_cd value = 1 days = 14 }
				}
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 15
		}
	}

	# The purchase acts on the company selected on the pyramid and stores its
	# target, so a later change of selection does not move the bought vote.
	# The vote lasts until the next annual meeting, which resets the purchases.
	NAM_board_buy_proxies = {
		icon = ADISCORD_deal
		allowed = { tag = NAM }
		visible = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_board_sole_vote_holder
			OR = {
				has_decision = NAM_board_buy_proxies
				AND = {
					NAM_board_operable = yes
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_selected value = 0 compare = greater_than }
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_selected value = 7 compare = less_than }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_board_buy_proxies_eligible_tt
				AND = {
					NAM_board_operable = yes
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_selected value = 0 compare = greater_than }
						check_variable = { var = NAM_board_selected value = 7 compare = less_than }
					}
					check_variable = { var = NAM_board_action_used value = NAM_board_action_slots compare = less_than }
					check_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_target value = 0 compare = equals }
					check_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_bought value = 2 compare = less_than }
				}
			}
		}
		cost = 0
		custom_cost_text = NAM_board_buy_proxies_cost
		custom_cost_trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_political_power < 15
			}
			check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 40 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		days_remove = 30
		cancel_trigger = {
			NAM_board_operable = no
		}
		complete_effect = {
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						hidden_trigger = {
							AND = {
								NAM_board_operable = yes
								AND = {
									check_variable = { var = NAM_board_selected value = 0 compare = greater_than }
									check_variable = { var = NAM_board_selected value = 7 compare = less_than }
								}
								check_variable = { var = NAM_board_action_used value = NAM_board_action_slots compare = less_than }
								check_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_target value = 0 compare = equals }
								check_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_bought value = 2 compare = less_than }
							}
							NOT = {
								has_political_power < 15
							}
							check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 40 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						}
					}
					set_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_target value = NAM_board_selected }
					NAM_board_take_action_slot = yes
					add_political_power = -15
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = -40 }
					NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
				}
			}
		}
		cancel_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_board_buy_proxies_refund_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				# The target is the receipt: NAM_board_end_operations may have refunded
				# and freed the slot already, so both steps test it first.
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_proxy_target > 0 } }
					NAM_board_release_action_slot = yes
				}
				NAM_board_buy_proxies_refund = yes
			}
		}
		remove_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_board_buy_proxies_result_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_proxy_target > 0 } }
					# The first company of the pyramid is read before the bought vote counts.
					if = {
						limit = {
							check_variable = { NAM_board_rank_1 > 0 }
							NOT = {
								check_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_target value = NAM_board_rank_1 compare = equals }
							}
						}
						set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_rank_1 }
						set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -5 }
						NAM_board_support_change = yes
					}
					add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_votes^NAM_board_proxy_target value = 1 }
					add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_bought value = 1 }
					NAM_board_release_action_slot = yes
					set_variable = { var = NAM_board_proxy_target value = 0 }
					NAM_board_recount = yes
				}
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
	}

# The Directory rebuilds on the islands what stayed on the mainland. Each
# programme is a paid chancery run of 60 days: the receipt NAM_dev_running^k
# settles progress and the material result at completion or refunds the
# capital on cancellation; NAM_dev_runs^k allows two runs per campaign, three
# once NAM_mdr_directory_of_six is completed, each run after the first only
# while the sponsoring company supports the council.
NAM_directory_development = {
	NAM_dev_census_halls = {
		icon = generic_political_discourse
		allowed = { tag = NAM }
		visible = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_board_salt_monopoly
			NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_board_ended = 1 } }
			OR = {
				OR = {

					}

									690 = { has_state_flag = NAM_mdr_restituted }

							}
						}

					}

						clr_state_flag = NAM_mdr_restitution_work

					}

						var = NAM_mdr_restitution_running
						min = 0

				}

					FROM = {
						if = {
							limit = { has_state_flag = NAM_mdr_restitution_work }
							clr_state_flag = NAM_mdr_restitution_work
							set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = NAM_mdr_restitution_paid }
							clear_variable = NAM_mdr_restitution_paid
							ROOT = {
								NAM_corp_capital_add = yes

									var = NAM_mdr_restitution_running
									min = 0
								}

						}
					}
				}

		}

				}

	# A treaty of concession offered to one emirate. At most two emirates
	# ever hold a treaty or a pending offer (NAM_mdr_desert_treaty_room), so
	# the great war always keeps a target. The escrow per emirate (1 Kadir,
	# 2 Sardan, 3 Rahma) is spent by a signature and refunded by a refusal,
	# by a vanished or invalid emirate (event 214), by a late answer, by the
	# lapse and by NAM_mdr_close. NAM_mdr_offer_target marks 1 paid, 2 sent.
	NAM_mdr_desert_offer = {
		icon = generic_diplomatic_treaty
		allowed = { tag = NAM }
		targets = { KDR SDR RHM }
		target_trigger = {
			FROM = {
				NAM_wor_independent_target = yes
				NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }

				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_mdr_offer_refused }
			}
		}
		visible = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_mdr_desert_concessions
			NOT = { has_global_flag = NAM_great_war_started }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = NAM_mdr_desert_lapsed }
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_board_governing_tt
				NAM_board_operable = yes
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_mdr_desert_treaty_room_tt
				NAM_mdr_desert_treaty_room = yes
			}
		}
		cost = 0
		custom_cost_text = NAM_mdr_desert_offer_cost
		custom_cost_trigger = {
			NOT = { has_political_power < 50 }
			check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		fire_only_once = no
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					hidden_trigger = {
						NAM_board_operable = yes
						NAM_mdr_desert_treaty_room = yes
						NOT = { has_global_flag = NAM_great_war_started }
						NOT = { has_global_flag = NAM_mdr_desert_lapsed }
						NOT = { has_political_power < 50 }
						check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						FROM = {
							NAM_wor_independent_target = yes
							NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
							NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_mdr_offer_pending }
						}
					}
				}
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_mdr_desert_offer_launch_tt
				hidden_effect = {
					if = {
						limit = { FROM = { tag = KDR } }

							size = 4
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { NAM_mdr_offer_target^num < 4 } }
						resize_array = {
							array = NAM_mdr_offer_target
							size = 4
							value = 0
						}

					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = -60 }
					NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
					set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_desert_escrow^NAM_mdr_desert_index value = 60 }

							flag = NAM_mdr_offer_pending
							days = 30

				}
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 30
			modifier = {
				factor = 2
				FROM = {
					strength_ratio = {
						tag = NAM
						ratio < 0.5
					}
				}
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				FROM = {

			if = {
				limit = {
					hidden_trigger = {

						NOT = { has_political_power < 20 }
						NAM_exile_drill_currency_ready = yes
					}
				}
				add_political_power = -20
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_exile_drill_started_tt
				hidden_effect = {
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = -30 }
					NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
					set_variable = { var = NAM_exile_drill_deposit value = 30 }
					set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_exile_drill_cd value = 1 days = 45 }
				}
			}
		}
		remove_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					hidden_trigger = {
						check_variable = { var = NAM_exile_drill_deposit value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
				}
				army_experience = 15
				# landing_contracts: the drill also trains the landing; a new drill restarts the 90 days.
				if = {
					limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_board_landing_contracts }
					navy_experience = 5
					if = {
						limit = { has_idea = NAM_board_landing_rehearsal_spirit }
						hidden_effect = { remove_ideas = NAM_board_landing_rehearsal_spirit }
					}
					add_timed_idea = {
						idea = NAM_board_landing_rehearsal_spirit
						days = 90
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_board_private_strait }
					custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_exile_drill_done_return_tt
				}
				else = {
					custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_exile_drill_done_tt
				}
				hidden_effect = {
					clear_variable = NAM_exile_drill_deposit
					NAM_judas_report_drill = yes
					if = {
						limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_board_private_strait }
						add_to_variable = { var = NAM_revenge_readiness value = 15 }
					}
					else = {
						add_to_variable = { var = NAM_revenge_readiness value = 10 }
					}
					NAM_revenge_readiness_clamp = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				effect_tooltip = {
					army_experience = 15
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_board_landing_contracts }
					effect_tooltip = {
						navy_experience = 5
						add_timed_idea = {
							idea = NAM_board_landing_rehearsal_spirit
							days = 90
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_board_private_strait }
					custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_exile_drill_done_return_tt
				}
				else = {
					custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_exile_drill_done_tt
				}
			}
		}
		cancel_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_exile_drill_refund_tt
			hidden_effect = { NAM_exile_drill_refund = yes }
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 10
		}
	}

# category.

# Council of boards: the war of return, shown while the war tree is loaded.
# Every paid run keeps its receipt in the scope it belongs to (a district's
# state flag or a NAM variable); cancel_effect, the remove-time recheck and
# NAM_rtw_close refund only while the receipt exists. has_decision is not used:
# it does not detect targeted decisions.
NAM_rtw_war = {
	# One order of the council at a time; the front focuses open its targets.
	NAM_rtw_order = {
		icon = generic_operation
		allowed = { tag = NAM }
		state_target = yes
		targets = { 688 67 701 700 690 69 }
		target_trigger = {
			FROM = {
				NOT = { is_controlled_by = ROOT }
				owner = { has_war_with = ROOT }

							state = 688
							state = 67
						}
					}
					has_completed_focus = NAM_rtw_north_front
				}
				AND = {
					FROM = {
						OR = {
							state = 700
							state = 690
						}
					}
					has_completed_focus = NAM_rtw_south_front
				}
				AND = {
					FROM = { state = 701 }
					has_completed_focus = NAM_rtw_march_on_loren
				}
				AND = {
					FROM = { state = 69 }
					has_completed_focus = NAM_rtw_storm_black_basin
				}
			}
		}
		highlight_states = { highlight_state_targets = { state = FROM } }
		on_map_mode = map_and_decisions_view

			has_completed_focus = NAM_rtw_war_cabinet

		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_rtw_order_free_tt
				NOT = { has_variable = NAM_rtw_order_target }
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_rtw_order_cooldown_tt
				NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_rtw_order_cooldown }
			}
			FROM = {
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = NAM_rtw_order_adjacent_tt
					NAM_rtw_order_adjacent = yes
				}
			}
		}
		cost = 0
		custom_cost_text = NAM_rtw_order_cost
		custom_cost_trigger = {
			NOT = { has_political_power < 25 }
			NOT = { command_power < 20 }
		}
		fire_only_once = no
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					hidden_trigger = {
						NOT = { has_variable = NAM_rtw_order_target }
						NOT = { has_political_power < 25 }
						NOT = { command_power < 20 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						FROM = {
							OR = {
								state = 701
								state = 69
							}
						}
					}
					# The same branch NAM_rtw_order_activate takes: the bridge bonus
					# of event 147 b lengthens only the Middle Loren order.
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_country_flag = NAM_rtw_order_extra_days
							FROM = { state = 701 }
						}

							add_timed_idea = {
								idea = NAM_rtw_capital_assault
								days = 150
							}
							add_days_mission_timeout = {
								mission = NAM_rtw_capital_order_mission

							}
						}
					}
					else = {
						effect_tooltip = {
							add_timed_idea = {
								idea = NAM_rtw_capital_assault
								days = 120
							}
						}
					}
				}
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_rtw_order_result_tt
				hidden_effect = {
					add_political_power = -25
					add_command_power = -20
					NAM_rtw_order_activate = yes
				}
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 30
			modifier = {
				factor = 2
				FROM = {
					OR = {
						state = 700
						state = 690
						state = 69
					}
				}
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0.25
				OR = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 100 compare = less_than }

# Council of boards: subversive operations against Eflor and Azhar, opened by
# the partition night. Residency operations 1-6 are run by the company whose
# trade it is and covered by the residency of the holder of the target's
# share. The receipt NAM_sub_op_kind on the target is the single escrow per
# target: it blocks every other residency operation there until completion,
# cancellation or exposure clears it. has_decision is not used, because it
# does not detect targeted decisions. The leaflets and the quarrel are council
# operations on a chancery slot with their receipts on NAM.
NAM_board_subversion = {
	NAM_sub_sand_in_tanks_op = {

					tooltip = NAM_sub_residency_free_tt
					NOT = { has_variable = NAM_sub_op_kind }

					NAM_sub_holder_backing = yes

			}

		ai_will_do = {

# ----- Council of boards: the continent, formations and army programmes -----
# Formation orders keep one receipt on NAM (a paid flag or variable) from
# payment to the formation, the cancellation or NAM_mdr_close; the receipt
# holds the amounts that a cancellation returns. Political power is never
# refunded. Formations are placed by NAM_mdr_place_division in state 700.
NAM_mdr_army = {
	# A district of the holders raises a line brigade for the council, three
	# per district. The receipt is on NAM, so a district annexed or lost
	# during the run still refunds.
	NAM_mdr_hire_district_regiments = {
		icon = ADISCORD_recruitment
		allowed = { tag = NAM }
		targets = { EFL AZH }
		target_trigger = {
			FROM = {
				NAM_board_federal_subject = yes
				OR = {
					AND = {
						tag = EFL
						ROOT = {
							has_completed_focus = NAM_mdr_eflor_concession
							check_variable = { NAM_mdr_hired_efl < 3 }
						}
					}
					AND = {
						tag = AZH
						ROOT = {
							has_completed_focus = NAM_mdr_basin_oil_concession
							check_variable = { NAM_mdr_hired_azh < 3 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		visible = {
			NAM_rtw_direct_rule = no
			OR = {
				has_completed_focus = NAM_mdr_eflor_concession
				has_completed_focus = NAM_mdr_basin_oil_concession
			}
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_board_governing_tt
				NAM_board_operable = yes
			}
			FROM = {
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = NAM_mdr_district_operating_tt
					NAM_board_operating_district = yes
				}
			}
		}
		cost = 0
		custom_cost_text = NAM_mdr_hire_district_regiments_cost
		custom_cost_trigger = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 30 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			NOT = { has_manpower < 6300 }
		}
		fire_only_once = no
		days_remove = 45
		cancel_if_not_visible = no
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					hidden_trigger = {
						NAM_board_operable = yes
						check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 30 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						NOT = { has_manpower < 6300 }
						FROM = { NAM_board_operating_district = yes }
						OR = {
							AND = {
								FROM = { tag = EFL }
								NOT = { has_variable = NAM_mdr_hire_paid_efl }
							}
							AND = {
								FROM = { tag = AZH }
								NOT = { has_variable = NAM_mdr_hire_paid_azh }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_mdr_hire_district_regiments_launch_tt
				hidden_effect = {
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = -30 }
					NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
					add_manpower = -6300
					if = {
						limit = { FROM = { tag = EFL } }
						set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_hire_paid_efl value = 1 }
					}
					else = {
						set_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_hire_paid_azh value = 1 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		remove_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_mdr_hire_district_regiments_result_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NAM_board_operable = yes
						FROM = { NAM_board_federal_subject = yes }
						OR = {
							AND = {
								FROM = { tag = EFL }
								has_variable = NAM_mdr_hire_paid_efl
							}
							AND = {
								FROM = { tag = AZH }
								has_variable = NAM_mdr_hire_paid_azh
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { FROM = { tag = EFL } }
						clear_variable = NAM_mdr_hire_paid_efl
						add_to_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_hired_efl value = 1 }
						set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_district value = 1 }
					}
					else = {
						clear_variable = NAM_mdr_hire_paid_azh
						add_to_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_hired_azh value = 1 }
						set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_district value = 2 }

					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_unit_state value = 700 }
					NAM_mdr_place_division = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						FROM = { tag = EFL }
						has_variable = NAM_mdr_hire_paid_efl
					}
					clear_variable = NAM_mdr_hire_paid_efl
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 30 }
					NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
					add_manpower = 6300
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						FROM = { tag = AZH }
						has_variable = NAM_mdr_hire_paid_azh
					}
					clear_variable = NAM_mdr_hire_paid_azh
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital_change value = 30 }
					NAM_corp_capital_add = yes
					add_manpower = 6300
				}
			}
		}
		cancel_trigger = {
			OR = {
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = NAM_mdr_cancel_paralysis_tt
					NAM_board_operable = no
				}
				FROM = {

								check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^10 = 2 }
								check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^10 value = NAM_board_selected compare = equals }
							}
							AND = {
								check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^11 = 2 }
								check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^11 value = NAM_board_selected compare = equals }
							}
						}
						check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 40 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						NOT = { has_manpower < 4900 }
						NOT = { has_equipment = { infantry_equipment < 4410 } }
					}
				}
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_hgm_lot_regiment_launch_tt
				hidden_effect = {
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_selected }
					NAM_hgm_lot_regiment_pay = yes
				}
			}
		}
		remove_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_hgm_lot_regiment_result_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				NAM_hgm_lot_regiment_deliver = yes
			}
		}
		cancel_trigger = {
			OR = {
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = NAM_mdr_cancel_paralysis_tt
					NAM_board_operable = no
				}
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = NAM_mdr_cancel_boycott_tt
					has_variable = NAM_hgm_regiment_company
					check_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance^NAM_hgm_regiment_company value = -1 compare = equals }
				}
			}
		}
		cancel_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_hgm_lot_regiment_refund_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				NAM_hgm_lot_regiment_refund = yes
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 15
			modifier = {
				factor = 0.25
				OR = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 80 compare = less_than }
					has_manpower < 15000
				}
			}
		}
	}

# ----- Council of boards: the southern chancery -----
# Operations against Shahrabad share one receipt on NAM (NAM_mdr_south_op_paid
# with the capital paid, NAM_mdr_south_op_kind 1-3): one operation runs at a
# time, and at most one penalty of the Directory weighs on Shahrabad at a time
# (NAM_mdr_shl_penalised). A completed operation succeeds in three cases of
# four; otherwise the plot is exposed. The orders of the War for the South and
# the Mazar retry stay here until the end of the route.

		allowed = { tag = NAM }
		visible = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_steel_and_oil_cartel
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_board_governing_tt
				NAM_board_operable = yes
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_hgm_programme_busy_tt
				NOT = { has_variable = NAM_hgm_export_paid }
			}
		}
		cost = 0
		custom_cost_text = NAM_hgm_export_contract_cost
		custom_cost_trigger = {
			NOT = { has_fuel < 15000 }
		}
		fire_only_once = no
		days_remove = 60
		days_re_enable = 90
		cancel_if_not_visible = no
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					hidden_trigger = {
						NAM_board_operable = yes
						NOT = { has_variable = NAM_hgm_export_paid }
						NOT = { has_fuel < 15000 }
					}
				}
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_hgm_export_contract_launch_tt
				hidden_effect = {
					NAM_hgm_export_pay = yes
				}
			}
		}
		remove_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_hgm_export_contract_result_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				NAM_hgm_export_deliver = yes
			}
		}
		cancel_trigger = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_mdr_cancel_paralysis_tt
				NAM_board_operable = no
			}
		}
		cancel_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_hgm_export_contract_refund_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				NAM_hgm_export_refund = yes
			}

			base = 15

				factor = 0.25
				has_fuel < 30000

	# Arms on credit to a country at war that is not the Khan's; the buyer pays at
	# the due day through NAM_hgm_loans_monthly. Three credits at most.
	NAM_hgm_arms_credit_sale = {
		icon = ADISCORD_arms_supply
		allowed = { tag = NAM }
		target_root_trigger = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_arms_on_credit
		}
		target_trigger = {
			FROM = {
				exists = yes
				NOT = { tag = ROOT }
				is_subject = no
				NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
				NOT = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT }
				has_war = yes
				NOT = { tag = RUS }
				NOT = { is_in_faction_with = RUS }
			}
		}
		visible = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_arms_on_credit
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_board_governing_tt
				NAM_board_operable = yes
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_hgm_arms_on_credit_cap_tt
				NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_hgm_credits^num > 2 } }
			}
		}
		cost = 0
		custom_cost_text = NAM_hgm_arms_credit_sale_cost
		custom_cost_trigger = {
			NOT = { has_equipment = { infantry_equipment < 6000 } }
			NOT = { has_equipment = { artillery_equipment < 48 } }
		}
		fire_only_once = no
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					hidden_trigger = {
						NAM_board_operable = yes
						NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_hgm_credits^num > 2 } }
						NOT = { has_equipment = { infantry_equipment < 6000 } }
						NOT = { has_equipment = { artillery_equipment < 48 } }
					}
				}
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_hgm_arms_on_credit_tt
				hidden_effect = {
					FROM = { NAM_hgm_open_credit = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 5
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				has_war = yes
			}
		}
	}

	# Fuel, or rifles when the Directory holds less than 10 000 fuel, sold to
	# a member of the coalition against the Khan. NAM_hgm_supply_pay holds the
	# goods until NAM_hgm_supply_deliver; four runs in all (NAM_hgm_supplies_sent,
	# returned on cancellation).
	NAM_hgm_coalition_supply = {
		icon = generic_trucks
		allowed = { tag = NAM }
		target_array = global.RUS_crisis_defenders
		target_root_trigger = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_envoys_beyond_the_desert
		}
		target_trigger = {
			FROM = {
				exists = yes
				NOT = { tag = ROOT }
				is_subject = no
				NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
				has_war_with = RUS
			}
		}
		visible = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_envoys_beyond_the_desert
			OR = {
				has_variable = NAM_hgm_supply_paid
				check_variable = { NAM_hgm_supplies_sent < 4 }
			}
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_board_governing_tt
				NAM_board_operable = yes
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_hgm_coalition_supply_cap_tt
				check_variable = { NAM_hgm_supplies_sent < 4 }
				NOT = { has_variable = NAM_hgm_supply_paid }
			}
		}
		cost = 0
		custom_cost_text = NAM_hgm_coalition_supply_cost
		custom_cost_trigger = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_fuel < 10000 }
				NOT = { has_equipment = { infantry_equipment < 5000 } }
			}
		}
		fire_only_once = no
		days_remove = 30
		days_re_enable = 60
		cancel_if_not_visible = no
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					hidden_trigger = {
						NAM_board_operable = yes
						check_variable = { NAM_hgm_supplies_sent < 4 }
						NOT = { has_variable = NAM_hgm_supply_paid }
						OR = {
							NOT = { has_fuel < 10000 }
							NOT = { has_equipment = { infantry_equipment < 5000 } }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_fuel < 10000 }
					}
					custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_hgm_coalition_supply_fuel_tt
					hidden_effect = {
						set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_supply_kind value = 1 }
					}
				}
				else = {
					custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_hgm_coalition_supply_rifles_tt
					hidden_effect = {
						set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_supply_kind value = 2 }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = {
					NAM_hgm_supply_pay = yes
					add_to_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_supplies_sent value = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		remove_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_hgm_coalition_supply_result_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				FROM = { NAM_hgm_supply_deliver = yes }
			}
		}
		cancel_trigger = {
			OR = {
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = NAM_mdr_cancel_paralysis_tt
					NAM_board_operable = no
				}
				FROM = {
					custom_trigger_tooltip = {
						tooltip = NAM_hgm_cancel_supply_target_tt
						OR = {
							NOT = { exists = yes }
							NOT = { has_war_with = RUS }
							is_in_faction_with = RUS
							has_war_with = ROOT
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		cancel_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_hgm_coalition_supply_refund_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = NAM_hgm_supply_paid
					}
					add_to_variable = { var = NAM_hgm_supplies_sent value = -1 }
				}
				NAM_hgm_supply_refund = yes
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 15
			modifier = {
				factor = 0.25
				has_fuel < 30000
				has_equipment = { infantry_equipment < 20000 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# ----- Council of boards: the partition and the dominion of the South -----
# Private tenders NAM_ptn_tender_1..11 lay one lot each before the council (NAM_ptn_start_tender
# / NAM_ptn_finish_tender); the night skips a lot under tender. Paid programmes
# keep their receipt in their pay effect until delivery, cancellation or
# NAM_hgm_close.

		icon = ADISCORD_deal
		allowed = { tag = NAM }
		visible = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_south_under_sequestration
			check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^1 = 1 }

			has_variable = NAM_ptn_shl_form
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_board_governing_tt
				NAM_board_operable = yes
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_ptn_tender_busy_tt
				check_variable = { NAM_ptn_tender_running^1 = 0 }
			}
		}
		cost = 25
		fire_only_once = no
		days_remove = 7
		cancel_if_not_visible = no
		complete_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_ptn_tender_launch_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_input value = 1 }
				NAM_ptn_start_tender = yes
			}
		}
		remove_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_ptn_tender_result_tt
			hidden_effect = {

					}
					NAM_ptn_finish_tender = yes

					NAM_ptn_cancel_tender = yes

	# The lowest kept lot that may be sold again goes under the hammer in
	# re-tender mode; NAM_ptn_start_retender fixes the lot when the price is
	# paid, so the decision settles the lot it was bought for.
	NAM_ptn_retender = {
		icon = ADISCORD_deal
		allowed = { tag = NAM }
		visible = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_southern_exchange
			NOT = { has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_perpetual_council }
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_board_governing_tt
				NAM_board_operable = yes
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_ptn_retender_lot_tt
				NAM_ptn_retender_available = yes
			}
		}
		cost = 40
		fire_only_once = no
		days_remove = 14
		days_re_enable = 60
		cancel_if_not_visible = no
		complete_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_ptn_retender_launch_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				NAM_ptn_start_retender = yes
			}
		}
		remove_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_ptn_retender_result_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NAM_board_operable = yes
						NOT = { has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_perpetual_council }
					}
					NAM_ptn_finish_retender = yes
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_retender_open value = 0 }
				}
			}
		}
		cancel_trigger = {
			OR = {
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = NAM_mdr_cancel_paralysis_tt
					NAM_board_operable = no
				}
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = NAM_ptn_cancel_perpetual_tt
					has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_perpetual_council
				}
			}
		}
		cancel_effect = {
			hidden_effect = {
				set_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_retender_open value = 0 }
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 5
			modifier = {
				factor = 0.25
				has_political_power < 80
			}
		}
	}

	# The council pays off the company selected on the pyramid.
	NAM_ptn_compensate = {
		icon = ADISCORD_treasury
		allowed = { tag = NAM }
		visible = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_nothing_left_to_divide
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_board_governing_tt
				NAM_board_operable = yes
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_ptn_compensate_company_tt
				check_variable = { NAM_board_selected > 0 }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { NAM_ptn_grievance^NAM_board_selected > 0 }
					check_variable = { NAM_board_support^NAM_board_selected < 35 }
				}
			}
		}
		cost = 0
		custom_cost_text = NAM_ptn_compensate_cost
		custom_cost_trigger = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		fire_only_once = no
		days_re_enable = 30
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					hidden_trigger = {
						NAM_board_operable = yes
						check_variable = { NAM_board_selected > 0 }
						OR = {
							check_variable = { NAM_ptn_grievance^NAM_board_selected > 0 }
							check_variable = { NAM_board_support^NAM_board_selected < 35 }
						}
						check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_ptn_compensate_tt
				hidden_effect = {
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_selected }
					NAM_ptn_compensate_deliver = yes
				}
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 10
			modifier = {
				add = 30
				check_variable = { var = NAM_board_stance^NAM_board_selected value = -1 compare = equals }
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 120 compare = less_than }
			}
		}
	}

	# The first company by votes buys the selected company's lowest South
	# lot, else its first district (NAM_hgm_buyout_deliver). NAM_hgm_buyout_company
	# names the seller from the start, so a later selection does not change the
	# deal. Three buy-outs in all.
	NAM_hgm_buyout = {
		icon = generic_political_pressure
		allowed = { tag = NAM }
		visible = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_mergers_and_buyouts
			NOT = { has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_perpetual_council }
			OR = {
				has_variable = NAM_hgm_buyout_company
				check_variable = { NAM_hgm_buyouts_done < 3 }
			}
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_board_governing_tt
				NAM_board_operable = yes
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_hgm_buyout_cap_tt
				check_variable = { NAM_hgm_buyouts_done < 3 }
				NOT = { has_variable = NAM_hgm_buyout_company }
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_hgm_buyout_company_tt
				check_variable = { NAM_board_selected > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { var = NAM_board_selected value = NAM_board_rank_1 compare = equals } }
				OR = {
					OR = {
						AND = {
							check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^1 = 2 }
							check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^1 value = NAM_board_selected compare = equals }
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^2 = 2 }
							check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^2 value = NAM_board_selected compare = equals }
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^3 = 2 }
							check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^3 value = NAM_board_selected compare = equals }
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^4 = 2 }
							check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^4 value = NAM_board_selected compare = equals }
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^5 = 2 }
							check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^5 value = NAM_board_selected compare = equals }
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^6 = 2 }
							check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^6 value = NAM_board_selected compare = equals }
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^7 = 2 }
							check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^7 value = NAM_board_selected compare = equals }
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^8 = 2 }
							check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^8 value = NAM_board_selected compare = equals }
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^9 = 2 }
							check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^9 value = NAM_board_selected compare = equals }
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^10 = 2 }
							check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^10 value = NAM_board_selected compare = equals }
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^11 = 2 }
							check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^11 value = NAM_board_selected compare = equals }
						}

			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_hgm_buyout_result_tt

				if = {
					limit = {
						NAM_board_operable = yes
						has_variable = NAM_hgm_buyout_company
						OR = {
							OR = {
								AND = {
									check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^1 = 2 }
									check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^1 value = NAM_hgm_buyout_company compare = equals }
								}
								AND = {
									check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^2 = 2 }
									check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^2 value = NAM_hgm_buyout_company compare = equals }
								}
								AND = {
									check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^3 = 2 }
									check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^3 value = NAM_hgm_buyout_company compare = equals }
								}
								AND = {
									check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^4 = 2 }
									check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^4 value = NAM_hgm_buyout_company compare = equals }
								}
								AND = {
									check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^5 = 2 }
									check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^5 value = NAM_hgm_buyout_company compare = equals }

								}

					}

		}
		cancel_trigger = {
			OR = {
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = NAM_mdr_cancel_paralysis_tt
					NAM_board_operable = no
				}
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = NAM_hgm_cancel_holding_lost_tt
					has_variable = NAM_hgm_buyout_company
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							OR = {
								AND = {
									check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^1 = 2 }
									check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^1 value = NAM_hgm_buyout_company compare = equals }
								}
								AND = {
									check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^2 = 2 }
									check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^2 value = NAM_hgm_buyout_company compare = equals }
								}
								AND = {
									check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^3 = 2 }
									check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^3 value = NAM_hgm_buyout_company compare = equals }
								}
								AND = {
									check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^4 = 2 }
									check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^4 value = NAM_hgm_buyout_company compare = equals }

									check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^5 value = NAM_hgm_buyout_company compare = equals }

									check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^6 = 2 }
									check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^6 value = NAM_hgm_buyout_company compare = equals }
								}
								AND = {
									check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^7 = 2 }
									check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^7 value = NAM_hgm_buyout_company compare = equals }
								}
								AND = {
									check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^8 = 2 }
									check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^8 value = NAM_hgm_buyout_company compare = equals }
								}
								AND = {
									check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^9 = 2 }
									check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^9 value = NAM_hgm_buyout_company compare = equals }
								}
								AND = {
									check_variable = { NAM_ptn_lot_state^10 = 2 }
									check_variable = { var = NAM_ptn_lot_owner^10 value = NAM_hgm_buyout_company compare = equals }

	# A works settlement by a mine of the South: one military factory with
	# its slot. The state flag NAM_hgm_town_work holds the price; one settlement
	# is built at a time (NAM_hgm_towns_running), four in all.
	NAM_hgm_company_towns = {
		icon = ADISCORD_factory
		allowed = { tag = NAM }
		state_target = yes
		target_array = NAM.NAM_conquered_states
		target_trigger = {
			FROM = {
				is_owned_by = ROOT
				NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT }
				OR = {
					is_core_of = SHL
					is_core_of = KYZ
					is_core_of = GLP
					is_core_of = MZR
					is_core_of = WEF
					is_core_of = KDR
					is_core_of = SDR
					is_core_of = RHM
				}
				NOT = { has_state_flag = NAM_hgm_town_work }
			}
		}
		highlight_states = { highlight_state_targets = { state = FROM } }
		on_map_mode = map_and_decisions_view
		visible = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_hgm_factory_towns
			OR = {
				check_variable = { NAM_hgm_towns_running > 0 }
				check_variable = { NAM_hgm_towns_built < 4 }
			}
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_board_governing_tt
				NAM_board_operable = yes
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_hgm_company_towns_cap_tt
				check_variable = { NAM_hgm_towns_built < 4 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_hgm_towns_running > 0 } }
			}
			FROM = {
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = NAM_mdr_state_held_tt
					is_owned_by = ROOT
					is_controlled_by = ROOT
				}
			}
		}
		cost = 0
		custom_cost_text = NAM_hgm_company_towns_cost
		custom_cost_trigger = {
			check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			NOT = { has_manpower < 4000 }
		}
		fire_only_once = no
		days_remove = 60
		cancel_if_not_visible = no
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					hidden_trigger = {
						NAM_board_operable = yes
						check_variable = { NAM_hgm_towns_built < 4 }
						NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_hgm_towns_running > 0 } }
						check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
						NOT = { has_manpower < 4000 }
						FROM = {
							NOT = { has_state_flag = NAM_hgm_town_work }
						}
					}
				}
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_hgm_company_towns_launch_tt
				hidden_effect = {
					FROM = { NAM_hgm_town_pay = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		remove_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_hgm_company_towns_result_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				FROM = { NAM_hgm_town_deliver = yes }
			}
		}
		cancel_trigger = {
			OR = {
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = NAM_mdr_cancel_paralysis_tt
					NAM_board_operable = no
				}
				FROM = {
					custom_trigger_tooltip = {
						tooltip = NAM_mdr_cancel_state_lost_tt
						OR = {
							NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT }
							NOT = { is_controlled_by = ROOT }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		cancel_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_hgm_company_towns_refund_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				FROM = { NAM_hgm_town_refund = yes }
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 10
			modifier = {
				factor = 0.25
				OR = {
					check_variable = { var = NAM_corp_capital value = 120 compare = less_than }
					has_manpower < 20000
				}
			}
		}
	}
